nodes.label: Vision Engine Python Dependencies
nodes.rationale: Specifies lower-bounded dependencies matching the CV/OCR pipeline (opencv-python-headless, numpy, onnxruntime, rapidocr-onnxruntime, rapidfuzz, scikit-image, pydantic) while using requests>=2.31.0 for HTTP transport instead of python-socketio[client].

nodes.label: Stage 1: Pre-Match Roster Manifest & Normalization
nodes.rationale: Treats live kill detection as closed-set classification against 48 lobby players (12 teams x 4 players) with ASCII skeleton indexing and pre-match lobby slot glyph calibration (0 vs O, 1 vs l vs I).

nodes.label: Stage 2: High-Signal Video Ingestion & ROI Blueprint
nodes.norm_label: stage 2: high-signal video ingestion & roi blueprint
nodes.rationale: Ingests 1080p directly via OBS Virtual Camera, NDI, or RTMP at 4-5 FPS (12-20 observations per 3-5s banner) and crops to ROI A (Kill-Feed), ROI B (Alive Counter), and ROI C (Game-State Guard) to prevent replay counting and compression OCR errors.

nodes.label: Stage 3: Change-Gated Row Parsing & Icon Classification
nodes.norm_label: stage 3: change-gated row parsing & icon classification
nodes.rationale: Applies SSIM/grayscale pixel diff gating (70-85% compute reduction), 3-5 row strip segmentation, YOLOv11-nano ONNX or template/color icon classification for Knock vs Elimination filtering and (x_min, x_max) Left/Right splitting, plus 2x-3x bicubic + CLAHE + adaptive thresholding.

nodes.label: Stage 4: OCR & Roster-Constrained Fuzzy Matching
nodes.rationale: Runs RapidOCR or PaddleOCR (~15-40 ms/crop) + RapidFuzz partial_ratio/WRatio against 48 skeletons with 3-tier confidence routing (>=85%, 65-84%, <65%), environment kill handling (killer_id=NULL), and self-kill prevention (killer.team_id != victim.team_id).

nodes.label: Stage 6: Event-Sourced Ranking Engine, OBS Overlay & Referee Fail-Safe
nodes.norm_label: stage 6: event-sourced ranking engine, obs overlay & referee fail-safe
nodes.rationale: Aggregates immutable kill_events dynamically (zero math drift), sorts by total_kills/tournament points, alive_players, and first_to_reach_timestamp, pushes WebSocket diffs to 1920x1080 30 FPS OBS Browser Source, and pairs with 1-click Referee Confirm/Reassign/Undo during the 10-30s broadcast delay.

nodes.label: Stage 5: Temporal Consensus & Revival-Aware Deduplication
nodes.rationale: Requires 2-of-3 consecutive sample consensus over a 1.2s window, maintains a 15s sliding hash H(killer_id, victim_id) cooldown to support Revival Points/Vending Machines without double-counting 4-5s banners, and cross-checks ROI B Alive count (>5s divergence alert).
